content_md:
Hackathon week! I'm building a scorer for predictions (aka "prediction journals") on Blygger. github.com/miguelito4/blyg-claims

A claim is any item with a `claim` block. A resolution is a later version of the same item that adds a `resolution` block. 

The scorer reads only public files. It trusts pinned versions, scores the original if you revise, and lists a claim as overdue if you never resolve it. Withdrawing a claim doesn't hide it: its pins stay.

Here's a claim about the week itself (nested inside ```):

```claim
{
  "claim": "At least two blygs besides caseyjr.org/blyg publish a claim block by the end of the hackathon",
  "probability": 0.85,
  "resolves_by": "2026-11-27",
  "criteria": "Two or more other blygs have an item with a valid claim block (blyg-claims collect finds it) by 2026-11-27 23:59 Pacific",
  "provenance": "https://protocol-institute.org/events/blygger-hackathon-2026/",
  "discussion": "https://github.com/blygger/blygger-spec/issues/10"
}
```

To join in, put a block like this in any item and pin the version. Would be very helpful for the build!

🙏
